exposure: scheduled gestational age for a repeat planned cesarean section
cohort: Women with two or more previous cesarean sections (n=377)
finding: Scheduling a planned cesarean section at around 39 weeks compared with at around 38 weeks is associated with an increased risk for maternal adverse outcome with no apparent advantage in terms of neonatal outcome in women after two cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study exclusively examined planned cesarean sections and did not involve other modes of delivery.
